subject: general
question: Which Shiv Sena leader from India was elected as Member of Rajya Sabha from Maharashtra in July 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sanjay Raut**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Sanjay Raut was elected as a Member of the Rajya Sabha from Maharashtra in July 2022.**
 
• He is a member of the** Shiv Sena party and has been a vocal critic of the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP)**.
